run_collect_results: run the script to merge acc_trace.json files from client directories into total_trace.json
review_collect_results: review the script that aggregates distributed LaNAS client accuracy trace JSON files
refactor_collect_results: refactor the script to accept configurable client range and output path via arguments
summarize_collect_results: summarize the script that collects and merges accuracy trace data from up to 799 client directories
test_collect_results: test the script by creating sample client directories with acc_trace.json and verifying merged output
